name: walk-scale-fov
description: Walk-mode scale + field-of-view audit (WALK-SPAWN-CLEAR / WALK-HFOV-FLOOR): the walk-in spawn stands clear of furniture on the default flat, and a phone-portrait viewport keeps its sideways view instead of collapsing to tunnel vision (three's fov is vertical). Probes report the resolved vertical fov + the horizontal angle it yields.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const st = window.__store.getState(); st.endTour?.(); st.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); st.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); st.setManualHour?.(13); st.setLightsMode?.('on'); st.hideLoading?.() })()

steps.name: probe-desktop-camera
steps.eval: (() => { const c = window.__three.camera; const h = 2 * Math.atan(Math.tan((c.fov * Math.PI) / 360) * c.aspect) * 180 / Math.PI; console.log('[probe] desktop', JSON.stringify({ pos: c.position.toArray().map(n => +n.toFixed(2)), vFov: +c.fov.toFixed(1), hFov: +h.toFixed(1), aspect: +c.aspect.toFixed(3) })) })()

steps.name: probe-spawn-clear
steps.eval: (() => { const c = window.__three.camera; const down = window.__three.raycaster; down.set(c.position, { x: 0, y: -1, z: 0 }); const hits = down.intersectObjects(window.__three.scene.children, true).filter(h => h.object.visible); console.log('[probe] spawn', JSON.stringify({ floorDistance: hits.length ? +hits[0].distance.toFixed(2) : null })) })()

steps.name: probe-phone-camera
steps.eval: (() => { const c = window.__three.camera; const h = 2 * Math.atan(Math.tan((c.fov * Math.PI) / 360) * c.aspect) * 180 / Math.PI; console.log('[probe] phone', JSON.stringify({ vFov: +c.fov.toFixed(1), hFov: +h.toFixed(1), aspect: +c.aspect.toFixed(3) })) })()
